# Binarise

> 🤖 *AI Drafted (Not reviewed)*

Black and white by Otsu or an adaptive threshold, written as a separate binarised rendition, without modifying source files.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Tool id | `binarise_images` |
| Category | transform |
| Uses a language model | no |
| Needs a generative model | no |
| Runs over many items | yes |
| Item handling | batch |
| Structured output | no |
| Human-verified | not yet |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `block` | integer | 31 | Adaptive neighbourhood in pixels; an even value is used as the next odd one. |
| `c` | integer | 2 | Subtracted from the adaptive local mean; larger keeps less ink. |
| `compression_quality` | integer | 90 | JPEG/WebP compression quality. |
| `method` | string | adaptive | One of: otsu, adaptive. |
| `output_dir` | string | — | Optional output directory. Defaults to a temp directory. |
| `output_format` | string | jpg | Derived image format. One of: jpg, png, tiff, webp. |

This tool does not send a prompt — it does its work in code.
